title: Packaged action activation: switching off an api-type packaged action (Ban User) does not stop it, because the activation consult runs only at action dispatch
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcUoS2G4jgqRskpExS7

Found in the 18.3.0 release-candidate browser walkthrough (wave anchor #27377, card W3-UX), at framework `main` @ `c4c515ad`.

## Repro (fresh boot)

1. Boot `examples/app-showcase` with `--seed-admin` and sign in as `admin@objectos.ai`.
2. Open **Setup → Packaged Automation → Packaged actions**. Switch **Ban User** (`ban_user`, object `sys_user`) off. The row reads off.
3. Open **Setup → Users**, open any non-admin user, click **Ban User**, then **Confirm**.

## Expected

The board's own copy says a packaged action that is turned off "stops running everywhere it is offered". So the ban should be refused, and the button should be hidden or disabled (see the sibling card about the button staying live).

## Actual

The user is banned. The toast says "User banned" and the header button becomes "Unban User".

## Reading

`ban_user` is declared `type: 'api'` with `target: '/api/v1/auth/admin/ban-user'` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`). The ADR-0126 §8 item 2 consult point sits at action dispatch (`packages/objectql/src/action-activation.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts`), and an `api` action's click goes straight to its target endpoint, so it never meets the ledger. Only `ban_user` was exercised. The other `api`-type packaged actions on `sys_user` and elsewhere (unban, set password, revoke sessions and so on) presumably share the path.

Either the board should not offer a switch it cannot honour for `api` actions, or the consult should also cover `api` actions.
